title: Arguments and configuration
hints: parseArgs: loop with an index, so that an option can consume the next argument: if the next one does not start with --, it is the value, and you skip it with i++.
For --name=value, split at the first = only: body.indexOf("=") and two slices.
loadConfig: Number.isInteger(port) && port >= 1 && port <= 65535, else throw new Error("PORT must be a number from 1 to 65535").
